Summary: Phase 0 — Foundations and a release
Description: Contracts frozen, corpus, gates, shell, v0.0.1 on macOS and Linux. Taste review #0 chooses the typeface pair. See docs/plan.md.

Summary: Freeze the contracts and make the workspace build
Acceptance: `pnpm install && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` green on macOS and Linux CI; contracts unchanged from the handoff commit (diff empty) or an ADR is added.

Summary: Enable branch protection, CODEOWNERS review and the PR template
Acceptance: A PR touching packages/theme cannot merge without a CODEOWNERS approval; direct push to main is rejected; squash is the only merge method.

Summary: Run the licence gate for real over the lockfile
Acceptance: `pnpm gate:licences` fails when a GPL package is added in a test branch and passes on main; every grammar in the allow-list has its licence recorded in the JSON.

Summary: Add lint and format (biome) and wire them into CI
Acceptance: `pnpm lint` exits non-zero on an unused import in a test branch; CI runs it on both runners.

Summary: Parse CommonMark + GFM into the AST with byte provenance
Acceptance: CommonMark spec suite passes (HTML output equivalence); every AST_INVARIANTS entry holds over fixtures/corpus; golden files for the corpus committed under packages/core/goldens and `pnpm gate:golden` diff-checks them; parse of 01-long-technical.md < 10 ms in Node.

Summary: Sanitise rendered HTML with the narrow default allow-list
Acceptance: Rendering 10-hostile.md yields zero script/iframe/object/form/meta/link elements and zero javascript:/data: hrefs; `pnpm gate:no-network` passes over the corpus in WebKit and Chromium; a unit test enumerates every forbidden vector in the hostile fixture.

Summary: Desktop shell opens a file from the command line and renders it unstyled
Acceptance: On macOS and Linux, `marxy fixtures/corpus/02-readme-real-world.md` shows the rendered document; the app prints `MARK first_text <epoch ms>` on the first frame after render and exits when MARXY_QUIT_AFTER_PAINT=1; all file access goes through packages/shell-api (grep for `invoke(` outside apps/desktop/src/shell returns nothing).

Summary: Byte-faithful open and save through shell-api
Acceptance: For every corpus file including 12-crlf-and-bom.md and 13-no-trailing-newline.md, open→save produces identical bytes (sha256 equal); save is write-temp-then-rename in the same directory; `pnpm gate:fidelity` asserts it.

Summary: Measure cold start in CI and enforce the budget
Acceptance: CI runs the packaged app 8× on both runners and writes results/perf.json; `pnpm gate:perf` fails when cold_start_first_text_ms > 500; the measured median is posted as a PR comment.

Summary: Ship v0.0.1 on macOS and Linux from a tag
Acceptance: Tagging v0.0.1 produces a GitHub pre-release with a .dmg (unsigned until secrets exist) and an .AppImage and .deb; the DMG mounts and the app launches on macOS 26; the AppImage launches on Ubuntu 24.04; bundle gate passes.

Summary: Produce the taste review #0 artifact: two typeface pairs on the long document
Acceptance: Two PNG sets (Literata + JetBrains Mono; Source Serif 4 + IBM Plex Mono) of 01-long-technical.md at the type scale, 1× and 2×, 68ch, appended to docs/taste-review/queue.md with the review checklist from ADR-0015.

Summary: Phase 1 — The page
Description: Rendered mode passes the mechanical aesthetics tier; taste review #1 is the first blind side-by-side. v0.1.

Summary: Default theme as a theme: tokens, grid-derived spacing, type scale, light
Acceptance: Every vertical margin/padding in the rendered corpus is an integer multiple of --marxy-line-box (Playwright measurement, tolerance 0.5px); measure 60–75ch at 14/17/21/24px; theme lint passes; the theme loads through the same loader user themes will use.

Summary: Bundle Literata and JetBrains Mono with the per-platform weight offset
Acceptance: Fonts load before first text (document.fonts.ready precedes MARK first_text); no FOUT in the screenshot sequence; --marxy-weight-offset is applied on Linux only; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES lists both OFL files.

Summary: Run the weight harness on a real Linux desktop and record the offset
Acceptance: The spike specimen and analyser (from ~/Dev/marxy-spike) run on GNOME at 1× and 2× against the macOS reference; the measured offset at 400 and 600 is recorded in an ADR-0010 follow-up and set as the Linux default; residual |offset| ≤ 25 after compensation.

Summary: Ragged-right Knuth–Plass through justif/core on paragraphs, list items and quotes
Acceptance: Body text remains inline HTML (selection, find-in-page and copy work in a Playwright test); rag metrics on the corpus improve versus engine wrapping (CV of line lengths −15% or better, short-line count lower); viewport typeset < 100 ms on 01-long-technical.md; a decision note records justif/core vs tex-linebreak2.

Summary: Hanging punctuation, protrusion and allow-listed hyphenation
Acceptance: Opening quotes and line-end hyphens sit outside the text edge by ≥ 40% of their advance in a measured screenshot; only en-us/en-gb patterns ship; licence gate passes.

Summary: Headless render entry and the full mechanical aesthetics gate
Acceptance: apps/desktop/dist/render.js renders a corpus file to HTML+CSS without the shell; the gate runs grid, measure, contrast, zero-CLS, rag and heading checks over the corpus in Playwright WebKit and WebKitGTK; baselines committed; MARXY_AESTHETICS_REQUIRED=1 in CI.

Summary: Images with reserved dimensions, remote images blocked with a notice
Acceptance: CLS = 0 across image decode on 02-readme-real-world.md; every remote image in 10-hostile.md is replaced by an inline notice naming its host; local images resolve through shell.assetUrl scoped to the document directory.

Summary: Code blocks highlighted at parse time from the grammar allow-list
Acceptance: All 25 allow-listed languages highlight; an unknown language renders as plain code; long lines soft-wrap with a hanging indent and no per-block scrollbar; copy yields text without markup; highlighting 03-ai-plan.md adds < 30 ms.

Summary: KaTeX on first use, on the grid
Acceptance: KaTeX is not loaded for a document without math (network-free bundle check); 06-math.md display blocks occupy integer line boxes; inline math baseline-aligned in a screenshot diff.

Summary: Smart typography as a render pass
Acceptance: Quotes, dashes, ellipses and a non-breaking space before a short last word appear in rendered output for 09-gfm-everything.md while the source bytes are unchanged (fidelity gate).

Summary: Screenshot baselines and diff gate per engine
Acceptance: Baselines for WebKit (Playwright, macOS) and WebKitGTK (Linux runner) committed for every corpus file; a 1px shift in a heading margin fails the gate; updating baselines requires a queue entry.

Summary: Taste review #1 artifact: blind side-by-side against Typora and Marked 2
Acceptance: Three corpus documents rendered in marxy, Typora and Marked 2 at 68ch, labelled A/B/C, plus the fourth-page scroll capture, in docs/taste-review/2026-xx-review-1/.

Summary: Phase 2 — The opener
Description: Under budget, watching, instant switching, Source mode. v0.2.

Summary: Cold-start waterfall under 500 ms with fonts eager and everything else deferred
Acceptance: results/perf.json median < 400 ms on both CI runners; grammars, KaTeX and the index are not loaded before MARK first_text (bundle-graph assertion); a waterfall JSON is attached to the PR.

Summary: Watch the root and live-reload the open document keeping the reading position
Acceptance: Tests cover in-place write, write-temp-then-rename, delete and move while open; after a reload the first visible block byteOffset is unchanged; reload < 100 ms on 01-long-technical.md.

Summary: Index the enclosing repository with ignore rules, deny list and ceiling
Acceptance: Root detection matches ADR-0012 in tests (repo, no repo); node_modules never indexed; 50k ceiling triggers the notice; index build of a 20k-file tree < 2 s and never precedes first paint; persisted and invalidated by mtime.

Summary: Palette: MRU, fuzzy over path/title/headings, pinning, back/forward
Acceptance: Keystroke to results p95 < 16 ms on a 20k index; empty query shows MRU newest first with pinned on top; heading hits jump; back/forward keys work; no tab bar exists (DOM assertion).

Summary: Source mode in CodeMirror 6 with per-file-type default and position-preserving switch
Acceptance: .rs/.ts/.py/.css open in Source, .md in Rendered; toggling twice returns to the same byteOffset; a 9 MB file scrolls with no frame > 100 ms; multi-cursor and undo work.

Summary: Reading position persisted per file across launches
Acceptance: Reopening a document restores the same first visible block within one line; position is a ReadingPosition, never scrollTop (grep assertion); debounced writes.

Summary: Taste review #2 artifact including the palette-vs-tabs criterion
Acceptance: A recorded task script for the reviewer (five documents, find the one from three switches ago) and screenshots of the palette states.

Summary: Phase 3 — Operations, safety, themes
Selection model in Rendered mode resolving to byte ranges
Acceptance: Span, block, section and document selections resolve to ranges whose bytes match the selected text (property test over the corpus); selection survives re-render.

Summary: Operations: copy section and copy code block clean
Acceptance: Table-driven tests; clipboard text has no fence, no highlight markup; offered only when the selection matches; palette-reachable.

Summary: Operations: toggle task item and align table pipes
Acceptance: Toggling rewrites exactly the TaskMarker bytes; aligning touches only the table range; fidelity property over every list item and table in the corpus; single undo step; visible summary.

Summary: Per-document opt-in that widens the sanitiser allow-list, with a discoverable notice
Acceptance: 02-readme-real-world.md shows a notice naming what was removed; opting in renders img/details/div align through the sanitiser; javascript: still stripped after opt-in; the choice persists per file.

Summary: Final CSP and capability set; no-network gate over the packaged app
Acceptance: CSP has no wildcard and no http(s) source; the gate runs against the built renderer; zero requests over the corpus including themes with url().

Summary: Dark variant designed, not inverted
Acceptance: Contrast ≥ 7:1; body weight and code background chosen for dark (not the light values negated); screenshot baselines for dark; queue entry.

Summary: User theme loading under the contract; a theme opens as a document
Acceptance: A theme directory with theme.toml + theme.css applies on launch and on file change with re-layout; contract version mismatch shows a warning; opening theme.css lands in Source mode; a theme url() to the network is blocked (gate).

Summary: Outline, find at reading position, keyboard completeness, open in external editor
Acceptance: Outline tracks the current heading while scrolling; find highlights matches inside typeset paragraphs and scrolls the match to the reading position; every action reachable without a pointer (audit checklist in the PR); external editor opens at the line.

Summary: Explicit save, byte-faithful and atomic, from either mode
Acceptance: Save after an operation changes only the operation range (fidelity gate); unsaved state indicated without chrome (title only); atomic rename verified.

Summary: Phase 4 — Ship
Description: v1.0 on both platforms with tier 2 passed.

Summary: Work the taste-review backlog in priority order
Acceptance: Each queue item closed with a before/after pair and a reviewer decision recorded.

Summary: Signed, notarized macOS DMG; AppImage and Flatpak; notices and attributions
Acceptance: Gatekeeper opens the DMG with no override; Flatpak installs from the bundle; about surface credits Literata, JetBrains Mono, Tauri; notices generated in CI.

Summary: Tighten perf and bundle budgets to measured values minus headroom
Acceptance: Budgets set to 1.2× the measured medians; CI green.

Summary: Tier 2 review on a Linux laptop and a Mac; v1.0 tag
Acceptance: Blind side-by-side passes on both; first-reaction recorded; v1.0.0 released.
